_comment: Per-locale deck-title formula + keyword tuning for the title overhaul (replaces the old '{Type} {Worksheet} — {Theme} — {Level} — Set NNN | LessonCraftStudio' template). The ENGINE (segment assembly, separator join, 50-70 budget trim, HTML-escape, brand-drop) is shared in build-seo-head.js + catalog-export.js; this file supplies only the per-locale WORD ORDER + keyword/style choices a native SEO expert decides. Keyword STRINGS for type/theme/level still come from topics-taxonomy.json (do NOT duplicate here); this file tunes ORDER, the vocabulary-differentiator style, numeric-range phrasing, and which differentiator sources are enabled. '_default' is the EN-shaped fallback so any locale missing a block never crashes. numericTemplates are NOT inherited from _default for non-en locales (would leak English on themeless math decks) — a locale gets numeric phrasing only when its own block defines numericTemplates (or it is 'en'). Per CLAUDE.md §A.13.48, non-en blocks are authored by a 3-agent native ensemble (SEO + marketing + K-3 ed) in plan-mode per locale; sv/da/no/fi carry an [NSR-FLAG]. Only en/es/pt carry published decks today; the other 8 blocks ship ready for when those locales publish.

_schema.titleSegmentOrder: array of 'head'|'theme'|'diff'|'level' in render order; theme omitted automatically when the deck has no theme; level omitted when includeLevel=false; diff omitted when the differentiator kind is 'none'
_schema.includeLevel: boolean; whether the educational-level segment appears
_schema.vocab: { maxNouns:int, joinStyle:'ampersand'|'conjunction', casing:'title'|'preserve'|'lower' } — how the featured-vocabulary differentiator renders
_schema.numericTemplates: { '<exercise-type>': '... {max} ...', '_generic': '...' } — phrasing for the numeric-range differentiator on themeless math decks; per-locale strings
_schema.diff: { enableVocab:bool, enableNumeric:bool, enableMode:bool } — which differentiator sources are active (experts disable enableMode for locales whose exercise-mode names are sparse, to avoid English residue)
_schema.charBudget: { min:int, max:int } — target title length; trim order is 2-nouns -> 1-noun -> drop level -> (diff dropped last); theme is never dropped when set (protects the theme-in-title audit check)
